messages:
Sonia (partnerships): Quick question — marketplace reviewers keep asking how long we retain compliance artifacts (SOC, pen-test reports, questionnaires). Do we have a standard TTL for marketplace uploads?
Eli (security): We currently keep the latest SOC2 report + 12 months of rolling artifacts in the internal bucket. For marketplace, partners sometimes want 24 months. Need to align.
Priya (legal): From a contract perspective, we prefer 12 months but can make exceptions for enterprise deals. Need to check any marketplace-specific requirements (Azure/GCP/AWS have slight differences).
Jared (eng-ops): Technically fine to support variable TTLs. We can implement lifecycle rules on the S3 bucket and add a metadata tag like `marketplace:retain=24m`. Presigned links can be revoked / rotated.
Sonia (partnerships): Can we add a flag at upload time that sets retention policy per partner listing? E.g., marketplace X wants 24m, marketplace Y wants 12m.
Jared (eng-ops): Yep — upload flow can take `retain_months` and apply object lifecycle + tag. We'll also emit an event to a small ledger table so partnerships team can see expiration dates.
Eli (security): Important: encryption-at-rest using our KMS key + access logs. Also mark some reports as "sensitivity:high" so they require manual approval before purge.
Priya (legal): Also ensure we keep chain-of-custody metadata for pen tests: vendor name, test date, scope, signed attestation. That's commonly requested during marketplace security reviews.
Sonia (partnerships): Good call. Can we add those fields to the upload UI / API?
Jared (eng-ops): I'll add optional fields: `pentest_vendor`, `pentest_date`, `scope_summary`, and `signed_by`. If `sensitivity:high` is set we skip auto-delete and notify security 30 days before planned purge.
Tim (deploy-bot): Note: new lifecycle rule applied to bucket `redwood-marketplace-artifacts` at 2026-04-05T10:02Z by jared.
Eli (security): For SOC2 Type II we should keep the full report + testing period artifacts for at least 15 months to cover rolling windows. Let's call that baseline 15 months.
Priya (legal): So final suggested defaults: SOC2 -> 15 months, Pen-test -> 24 months, Questionnaires (short-form) -> 12 months. Contracts can override. Document this in the marketplace onboarding checklist.
Sonia (partnerships): Can someone draft the short paragraph to add to the partner onboarding doc and the upload modal? I can add it to the marketplace checklist once approved.
Jared (eng-ops): I'll draft the uploader copy and API param docs. Example snippet for teams: `curl -X POST /upload -F file=@report.pdf -F pentest_date=2026-03-01 -F retain_months=24`
Eli (security): Add note: all artifacts must be encrypted with `arn:aws:kms:...:key/redwood-marketplace` and access limited to the partnership-review role.
Priya (legal): Also include a line about how we respond to external auditors: we will provide redacted versions if required, and full artifacts under NDA only.
Sonia (partnerships): Perfect. Last item: notification cadence. Partners want a heads-up before we purge older artifacts. Can we email them 45/15/3 days out?
Jared (eng-ops): Yep. We'll wire SNS -> Lambda -> transactional email. Add an opt-in toggle for partner contacts.
Eli (security): And add an audit trail event when a report is viewed/downloaded by marketplace reviewers.
Sonia (partnerships): Thanks. Action items: Priya draft contract blurb; Eli finalize retention baselines and sensitivity rules; Jared implement uploader fields + lifecycle + notifications; I'll update the marketplace onboarding checklist and notify partners.
Priya (legal): I'll have a draft by EOD Friday.
Jared (eng-ops): ETA for uploader + lifecycle rule changes: next sprint (two weeks).
Eli (security): I'll circulate the sensitivity matrix and automated review playbook.
Tim (deploy-bot): Reminder: scheduled job `artifact-retention-check` runs daily at 03:00 UTC.
